description: CRIT-001 claims PROP-BILL-062 verifies '(5) customer_id persistence before charge'. However, the PROP-BILL-062 test at subscribe-flow.test.ts:726-795 does NOT instrument db.updateMemberCustomerId in the callOrder array. The test only records createCustomer and createCharge in sequence. The actual persistence step (updateMemberCustomerId at subscribe.ts:156) is not tracked, so the test verifies createCustomer < createCharge but NOT that customer_id is persisted to DB before charge. The contract criterion claims a stronger guarantee than the test actually provides. A Phase 3 adversary cannot evaluate '(5) customer_id persistence before charge' as PASS based on PROP-BILL-062 alone.

evidence.snippet: callOrder tracks: acquireAdvisoryLock, upsertProvisionalMember, setInflightOperation, consumeLinkSession, fetchToken, createCustomer, createCharge, createSubscription, updateMemberAfterSubscribe, assignRole. Missing: updateMemberCustomerId.
